titulo: "Last man" is not a law: when it's really a red card #shorts
descripcion:
Law 12 gives a red card for denying a goal or an obvious goal-scoring opportunity. Inside the box, if the defender was trying to play the ball, it's a penalty and a yellow. Holding, pulling, pushing or no chance of playing the ball: red card and penalty. Advantage and a goal: no card.

Source: Law 12, Laws of the Game 2026/27 (The IFAB), via https://futbolatlas.app/k/dogso

AI-generated voice and animation.
